A register screen and a silver foil snack bag printed with an orange pattern rest on the counter, shelves packed with snacks and daily goods run along the left, and the glass storefront door behind him stays fully closed, the dark night street and its distant lights showing beyond the glass. Cool white strip fluorescents overhead press an even, cold light across the room.
